overview: El Salvador is the smallest country in Central America and the only one without a Caribbean coastline. Its capital and largest city is San Salvador. El Salvador became independent from Spain in 1821, at first as part of a Central American federation. It uses the US dollar, and in 2021 it became the first country to adopt Bitcoin as legal money.

geography.text: El Salvador faces the Pacific Ocean. A line of volcanoes runs across the country, and earthquakes are common. Between the volcanic highlands and the coastal plain lies a central plateau where most people live, and the Lempa is its main river.
